**Türkiye: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 864,753 applications. The largest annual volume was 134,789 in 2015; 2025 recorded 6,459. Applications in 2025 were 89% lower than in 2019 (56,417). Applications in 2025 were 28% lower than in 2024 (9,009). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 0 of 3 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Afghanistan (3,472), Iraq (1,463), Unknown (910).

In 2023, the substantive protection rate was 46%, across 21,753 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 73% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 5.8 percentage points lower than in 2022 (52%). No eligible 2025 rate is available; 2023 is the latest reconciled year.
